conversations.prompt: How to force a rerender in Solid?
conversations.answer: In Solid, you can force a component to re-render by changing the state that the component depends on. If the state changes, the component will re-render to reflect those changes.In your case, you could introduce a new signal in the TasksList component, which will keep track of when the selected task changes. This signal can then be passed to the PromptDescriptorViewer as a prop, forcing it to re-render when the selected task changes.Here's the modification to the TasksList.jsx:[CODE_BLOCK_0]In this script, we've created a new signal selectedTask and updated it inside handleTaskChange. We then pass selectedTask() as the key prop to the PromptDescriptorViewer component. This is a common trick in many UI libraries/frameworks to force a re-render of a component: by changing the key prop, we effectively tell Solid to "recreate" the component instead of reusing the existing one. This would cause PromptDescriptorViewer to be re-mounted and fetch the updated descriptor whenever the selected task changes.
